loop_outputs.text: Proposed trigger: receive an entity-qualified invoice dispute for scoped preparation. The business start event and eligibility rule still need confirmation.
Proposed objective: prepare and coordinate an evidence-backed invoice-dispute disposition. This is the template assignment, not a result established by the queue.

Two distinct entity-qualified records are present in this retained upload: North dispute-17 and South dispute-18. This is an upload count, not the recurring eligible population or evidence of complete coverage.

Proposed close requirement: accountable owner/customer accepts an agreed disposition independently evidenced in its governing source. Settlement versus matched cash remains unresolved. This is not a source-established event or Case closure permission.

The note explicitly associated with North dispute-17 reports that DEL-4 delivery confirmation is not supplied. This supports the source report only; it does not prove non-delivery or customer impact. Identifying an evidence owner and obtaining governing terms remain proposed follow-up questions.

Proposed correction path: reuse an applicable D10 descriptive review; genuinely changed descriptions append a cited or explicitly operator-reported correction and require fresh descriptive confirmation plus separate pack publication approval. D-035 preserves originals; no rule or worker behavior promotes automatically.
